items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College with bassist Mitchell Player.

ctx.x: Bassist Mitchell Player is a longtime resident of New Orleans and a passionate advocate for the importance of the city’s unique culture. Mitchell has performed with some of the city’s best known artists, including Leroy Jones and Michael White.
Mitchell was interviewed in Clinton, New York, on November 8, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College with bassist Mitchell Player. Welcome to the north. I’m wondering, what’s the temperature in New Orleans right now?
